sourceLimitations: Only Python streams of completed-project GC/resources/control logs were read; no JVM, MAT, heap decoder or profile input was launched.
Per-run windows are exact START-to-END marker windows and include joined/static/cleanup work. Durations are not exact subphase windows.
joinedSealReleaseSeconds aggregates pre-bind capture/release plus post-bind close; it is not one contiguous interval. Binding log appears after close.
After-young-GC occupancy can include unreachable old objects; it is not a retained-heap census. Full-GC occupancy is a stronger low-water sample but has no owner attribution.
Cumulative pause-reclaimed bytes quantify churn through observed collections, not exact allocations or retained bytes; concurrent reclamation is not included.
Pause wall time is not native GC CPU. No GC/JIT/native CPU percentage is inferred.
RSS includes resident Java heap plus native/code/metadata/profiling/shared pages. RSS minus Xmx is not an exact native-owner measurement.
Without a fresh heap there is no actual-null-field, dominator, class-layout or measured release-byte census. Successful lifecycle logs are not such a census.

limits: JFR percentages use Java execution-sample count; native GC/JIT are outside that denominator. Collapsed percentages use all captured CPU stack weights.
Exclusive stages partition Java samples. Do not add overlapping inclusive frames.
No CPU sample share is converted to wall seconds or process CPU seconds.
OWASP normal.collapsed crosses forward1/backward2; no per-run CPU split is possible without timestamps.
Engine/static JFR phases split by logged binding duration; exact run resource/memory windows retain START->END markers including join/cleanup. Do not sum overlapping windows.
TB resource stream misses the final0.995s ofrun1; show covered CPU only, not a filled-in exact total.
JFR sampled allocation weight and cumulative reclaimed bytes describe churn, not live retained bytes.
After young GC low-water can include unreachable old objects. RSS includes native/code/metadata/profiling/shared pages and cannot assign owner retention.
